Entity.name: Exclusive relation
Entity.comment:
Relationships that emanate from an entity can be exclusive. I.e. none or 1 of them is possible, but never several simultaneously.
Example: a Person is reachable via Mobile-Phone or via Land-Line-Phone
Entity.notes:
[DE_ENTI_COMMENT[ Beziehungen die von einer Entität ausgehen können exklusiv sein. D.h. keine oder 1 davon ist möglich, aber nie mehrere gleichzeitig
Beispiel: eine Person ist erreichbar über Mobil-Telefon oder über Festnetz-Telefon ]DE_ENTI_COMMENT] [EN_ENTI_COMMENT[ Relationships that emanate from an entity can be exclusive. I.e. none or 1 of them is possible, but never several simultaneously.

Attribute.name: Number
Attribute.comment: Number to distinguish multiple exclusive groups of relationships in an entity. Making them an exclusive group of relationships
